heading: Deadline heap restored
text:
### Deadline heap restored [LDTL.4.2]

With `dynamic_ttl`, the deadline min-heap holds the deadline of every
`ttl` fact, whether or not it carries a per-emit override.
This is necessary because, even without explicit overrides, the presence
of the kwarg in the language means the engine cannot assume FIFO
expiry order across schemas.

| Operation | Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fact assert (TTL) | O(log N_ttl) | heap insert |
| Fact retract | O(log N_ttl) | heap remove |
| TTL tick | O(expired × log N_ttl) | Drain the heap while its earliest deadline is at or before the tick's instant |
